span.label: `zero-shot transfer` - A TERM RETIRED FOR A NAMED AMBIGUITY, WITH THE TWO READINGS SEPARATED: `the method is “zero-shot” IN THE SENSE THAT NO GRADIENT UPDATES ARE PERFORMED, but it often involves providing inference-time demonstrations to the model, SO IS NOT TRULY LEARNING FROM ZERO EXAMPLES.` **TWO DIFFERENT ZEROS** - zero weight updates and zero examples - collapsed into one word. The repair is a SPLIT: `meta-learning` for the outer structure and `in context-learning` for the inner loop, then `zero-`/`one-`/`few-shot` graded by demonstration count. NOT a redefinition; the old term is abandoned and its two senses are given separate names.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE VOCABULARY IS DELIBERATELY UNDER-SPECIFIED, AND THE AUTHORS SAY SO: `Quotation withheld.` A NAMING SCHEME BUILT NOT TO DECIDE A LIVE THEORETICAL DISPUTE. The word `learner` is in the paper's own title, and this footnote withdraws the reading that title invites. MOST DEFINITIONAL WORK IN THIS CORPUS NARROWS A TERM; THIS ONE WIDENS IT ON PURPOSE, so that adopting the vocabulary does not commit a reader to either answer.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `in-context learning` - THE COINAGE IS ATTACHED TO SOMEBODY ELSE'S WORK. `Recent work [RWC+19] ATTEMPTS TO DO THIS VIA WHAT WE CALL “IN-CONTEXT LEARNING”, using the text input of a pretrained language model AS A FORM OF TASK SPECIFICATION.` **The naming and the doing are separated: the prior paper did it, this paper named it.** `what we call` is doing that work explicitly, and the name is the one the field kept.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `zero-shot` / `one-shot` / `few-shot` - THE PAPER REFUSES THE COMPARATIVE FRAME ITS OWN NAMES INVITE. `with the aim of comparing them NOT AS COMPETING ALTERNATIVES, BUT AS DIFFERENT PROBLEM SETTINGS which offer A VARYING TRADE-OFF between performance on specific benchmarks and sample efficiency.` **A graded series of names - zero, one, few - reads as a ladder with a best rung, and the paper says in advance that it is not one.** Compare mechanism 26 (`brown2020` again): there the vocabulary is agnostic on a live dispute; here the vocabulary is agnostic about its own ordering. **NO EDGE PROPOSED, AND I WROTE ONE BEFORE DELETING IT.** I had `in-context learning --part-of--> zero-shot` with no `relation_evidence`, which passes the gate because the type-specific cue test only fires when that field is present. Twenty minutes earlier I refused to do exactly that on `cragg2017` and called it Q-930's shape. The cases are not even parallel in my favour: `cragg2017`'s paper DOES state its partition (`divided into three main components`) and only the cue list cannot see it, whereas this paper states the containment nowhere - which is the same reason the `gurnee2026` edge was dropped. **An edge that survives only because I left out the field that would have tested it is not evidence.**
